title: The First Demon Returns
summary: In an ethereal dreamscape communion, the redeemed spirit of First Sovereign Asmodaius grants Ha-Jun the final ancient blessing, bestowing the eternal Key of Creation.

panels.shot: morning sunshine streaming across saint mirren university campus wide
panels.action: A breathtaking, golden autumn morning across Saint Mirren University; students walking with backpacks under yellow trees.
panels.prose_en: A breathtaking, golden autumn morning across Saint Mirren University; students walking with backpacks under yellow trees.
panels.prose_hi: Sent miren vishwavidyalaya mein ek lubhavni, sunhari sharad ritu ki subah; peele pedon ke neeche backpack ke saath chalte chhatra.

panels.shot: ha-jun, tae-jun, and min-jae sitting around the rooftop picnic table
panels.action: The three young men sit around the table eating warm breakfast pastries and drinking fresh milk under the sun.

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: So you're telling me you literally anchored reality and then asked for grape soda?

panels.prose_en: The three young men sit around the table eating warm breakfast pastries and drinking fresh milk under the sun.
panels.prose_hi: Teenon yuvak mej ke charon or baithkar garm nashte ki pastry kha rahe hain aur suraj ki roshni mein taja doodh pee rahe han.

panels.shot: ha-jun taking a sip of milk wiping his mouth grinning
panels.action: Ha-Jun laughs with a white milk mustache: 'Hey, anchoring the multiverse is thirsty work!'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Grape soda is essential for cosmic stability.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun laughs with a white milk mustache: 'Hey, anchoring the multiverse is thirsty work!'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun safed dudhiya moonchhon ke saath hansta hai: 'are, multiverse mein anchoring karna pyasa kaam hai!'

panels.shot: tae-jun tossing a napkin at ha-jun face laughing
panels.action: Tae-Jun tosses a paper napkin: 'Wipe your lip, Your Divine Majesty.'
panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun tosses a paper napkin: 'Wipe your lip, Your Divine Majesty.'.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun ne ek paper napkin uchhala: 'apne honth ponchho, mahamahim.'

panels.shot: kuro pecking at a strawberry jam croissant on the table
panels.action: Kuro daintily nibbles on a flaky croissant: 'I approve of this culinary offering.'
panels.prose_en: Kuro daintily nibbles on a flaky croissant: 'I approve of this culinary offering.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro bade pyar se paratdaar croisain ko kutarta hai: 'mujhe yah pak peshkash manjoor hai.'

panels.shot: captain baek walking onto the terrace holding a golden ceremonial scroll
panels.action: General Baek arrives, carrying an official scroll stamped with the Presidential Seal of Korea.

dialogue.speaker: baek
dialogue.text: Excuse the interruption, gentlemen. The World Council has completed the new charter.

panels.prose_en: General Baek arrives, carrying an official scroll stamped with the Presidential Seal of Korea.
panels.prose_hi: Janaral bak korea ke rashtrapati ki muhar lagi ek adhikarik pustak lekar pahunche.

panels.shot: baek handing the scroll to ha-jun with a warm smile
panels.action: Baek hands the scroll to Ha-Jun: 'The United Defense Pact is officially dissolved. From today, we are the Guardians of Peace.'

dialogue.speaker: baek
dialogue.text: No more military hunters. Only protectors and educators.

panels.prose_en: Baek hands the scroll to Ha-Jun: 'The United Defense Pact is officially dissolved. From today, we are the Guardians of Peace.'.
panels.prose_hi: Bek ne scroll ko Ha-Jun ko saunp diya: 'sanyukt raksha sandhi adhikarik taur par bhang ho gai hai. aaj se, hum shanti ke sanrakshak han.'

panels.shot: ha-jun unrolling the scroll reading the grand charter
panels.action: Ha-Jun reads the calligraphy: 'Charter for the Coexistence of Mortal and Demonic Species.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: This is what Mom and Dad dreamed of.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun reads the calligraphy: 'Charter for the Coexistence of Mortal and Demonic Species.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun sulekh padhta hai: 'nashwar aur shaitani demonic prajatiyon ke sah-astitv ke liye charter.'

panels.shot: tae-jun looking over ha-jun shoulder with gentle pride
panels.action: Tae-Jun rests his chin on Ha-Jun's shoulder: 'They would be proud beyond words, Ha-Jun.'
panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun rests his chin on Ha-Jun's shoulder: 'They would be proud beyond words, Ha-Jun.'.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun apni thuddi Ha-Jun ke kandhe par rakhta hai: 'unhen shabdon se pare garv hoga, Ha-Jun.'

panels.shot: ha-jun touching the seal: a gentle golden rune permanently stamping the charter
panels.action: Ha-Jun presses his thumb to the wax; a soft golden Sovereign crest seals the document forever.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun presses his thumb to the wax; a soft golden Sovereign crest seals the document forever.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apna angutha mom par dabata hai; ek naram sunhari samprabhu shikha dastavej ko hamesha ke liye seal kar deti hai.

panels.shot: down in the courtyard: hundreds of human and demon students greeting each other
panels.action: Below in the courtyard, horned demon teenagers and human students walk together, sharing textbooks and laughing.

dialogue.text: The wall of fear had crumbled into bridges of understanding.

panels.prose_en: Below in the courtyard, horned demon teenagers and human students walk together, sharing textbooks and laughing.
panels.prose_hi: Niche aangan men, seeng wale rakshas kishore aur manav chhatra ek saath chalte han, paathyapustaken sajha karte hain aur hanste han.

panels.shot: ha-jun watching them with deep, serene fulfillment
panels.action: Ha-Jun leans on the balustrade, the warm morning breeze rustling his black hair, watching the happy children.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: This was worth every tear. Every scar.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun leans on the balustrade, the warm morning breeze rustling his black hair, watching the happy children.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun chhajje par jhuka hua hai, garm subah ki hawa uske kale baalon ko sarsrahat de rahi hai, khush bachchon ko dekh rahi hai.

panels.shot: kuro hopping onto ha-jun wrist nuzzling his sleeve
panels.action: Kuro rests his head against Ha-Jun's wrist: 'You gave them their future, Ha-Jun.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: You are the greatest Sovereign the stars will ever know.

panels.prose_en: Kuro rests his head against Ha-Jun's wrist: 'You gave them their future, Ha-Jun.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro apna sir Ha-Jun ki kalai par tika deta hai: 'aapne unhen unka bhavishya de diya, Ha-Jun.'

panels.shot: ha-jun petting kuro feathers with his thumb smiling
panels.action: Ha-Jun strokes Kuro's glossy plumage: 'I couldn't have done it without my best bird.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Tumhare bina main Episode 1 mein hi ruk jata.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun strokes Kuro's glossy plumage: 'I couldn't have done it without my best bird.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne Kuro ke chamakdar pankhon par prahar kiya: 'main apne sarvshreshth pakshi ke bina yah nahin kar pata.'

panels.shot: min-jae checking his watch gasping: 'class starts in five minutes!'
panels.action: Min-Jae checks his watch, panicking: 'Guys! Physics lecture with Professor Kang starts in five minutes!'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Pack your bags!! We can't be late on the first day of the semester!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae checks his watch, panicking: 'Guys! Physics lecture with Professor Kang starts in five minutes!'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je ne ghabrate hue apni ghadi dekhi: 'doston! professor kang ke saath bhautiki vyakhyan paanch minute mein shuru hoga!'

panels.shot: ha-jun and min-jae frantically stuffing textbooks into backpacks
panels.action: The two young men scramble, stuffing notebooks, pens, and pastry wrappers into their bags.
panels.prose_en: The two young men scramble, stuffing notebooks, pens, and pastry wrappers into their bags.
panels.prose_hi: Donon yuvak notebook, pen aur pastry rapper ko apne bag mein bharte hue hathapai karte han.

panels.shot: tae-jun and baek laughing heartily watching them scramble
panels.action: Tae-Jun and General Baek laugh from the bench, sipping their coffee in amusement.

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Run, kids! Don't let the professor lock the door!

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun and General Baek laugh from the bench, sipping their coffee in amusement.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun aur general bake bench se hanste hue, manoranjan mein apni coffee peete hue.

panels.shot: ha-jun slinging his backpack over his shoulder turning to tae-jun
panels.action: Ha-Jun slings his bag, grinning at Tae-Jun: 'See you at home for dinner, Hyung!'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Dinner pe milte hain, Hyung! Make sure you cook rice!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun slings his bag, grinning at Tae-Jun: 'See you at home for dinner, Hyung!'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apna bag uchhalta hai aur Tae-Jun ki or muskurate hue kehta hai: 'rat ke khane ke liye ghar par milte han, hung!'.

panels.shot: tae-jun waving with a warm, bright smile: 'rice will be ready!'
panels.action: Tae-Jun waves: 'I'll make your favorite stew! Now go!'
panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun waves: 'I'll make your favorite stew! Now go!'.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun lahren: 'main aapka pasandeeda stu banaunga! ab jao!'

panels.shot: ha-jun and min-jae sprinting down the campus stairs laughing
panels.action: Ha-Jun and Min-Jae sprint down the grand stone staircases, their sneakers squeaking on the polished marble.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun and Min-Jae sprint down the grand stone staircases, their sneakers squeaking on the polished marble.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun aur min-je bhavya patthar ki sidhiyon se teji se neeche utarte han, unke jute polish kiye gaye sangmarmar par charmara rahe han.

panels.shot: kuro gliding overhead keeping pace with the running students
panels.action: Kuro glides smoothly through the high arches above them, keeping effortless pace with his companions.
panels.prose_en: Kuro glides smoothly through the high arches above them, keeping effortless pace with his companions.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro apne sathiyon ke saath sahaj gati banae rakhte hue, unke upar oonche mehrabon ke madhyam se aasani se glide karta hai.

panels.shot: students and professors smiling and waving as ha-jun runs past
panels.action: Students call out: 'Morning, Ha-Jun!' 'Good luck on the quiz!' Ha-Jun waves back cheerfully.
panels.prose_en: Students call out: 'Morning, Ha-Jun!' 'Good luck on the quiz!' Ha-Jun waves back cheerfully.
panels.prose_hi: Chhatra pukarte han: 'subah, Ha-Jun!' 'prashnottari ke liye shubhakamnaen!' Ha-Jun khushi se wapas lautata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun and min-jae sliding through the lecture hall double doors just in time
panels.action: They slide through the classroom doors just as the bell chimes, breathless and laughing.
panels.prose_en: They slide through the classroom doors just as the bell chimes, breathless and laughing.
panels.prose_hi: Jaise hi ghanti bajti hai, ve bedam aur hanste hue kaksha ke darwazon se bahar nikal jaate han.

panels.shot: the professor smiling from the podium: 'take your seats, boys'
panels.action: Professor Kang smiles from the chalkboard: 'Take your seats, boys. Chapter 1: Foundations of Harmony.'
panels.prose_en: Professor Kang smiles from the chalkboard: 'Take your seats, boys. Chapter 1: Foundations of Harmony.'.
panels.prose_hi: Profacer kang chockboard se muskurate hue kahte han: 'apni seat le lo, ladkon. adhyay 1: sadbhav ki neen.'

panels.shot: ha-jun sliding into his window seat pulling out his notebook
panels.action: Ha-Jun sits by the sunny window, opening his clean notebook, his heart completely light.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun sits by the sunny window, opening his clean notebook, his heart completely light.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun dhoop wali khidki ke paas baithta hai, apni saaf notebook kholta hai, uska dil puri tarah se halka hota hai.

panels.shot: kuro perching on the outdoor windowsill looking through the glass
panels.action: Outside on the sunlit sill, Kuro settles down, winking through the clean glass at Ha-Jun.
panels.prose_en: Outside on the sunlit sill, Kuro settles down, winking through the clean glass at Ha-Jun.
panels.prose_hi: Bahar suraj ki roshni wali dehli par, Kuro baith jata hai, aur Ha-Jun mein saaf sheeshe se aankh maarta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun looking out the window at the blue sky smiling with complete fulfillment
panels.action: Ha-Jun gazes out at the cloudless blue sky, feeling the quiet, infinite rhythm of a peaceful universe.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: This is the world we fought for. And I will protect it forever.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun gazes out at the cloudless blue sky, feeling the quiet, infinite rhythm of a peaceful universe.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun badal rahit neele aakash ko dekhta hai, shantipurna brahmand ki shant, anant lay ko mahsoos karta hai.

panels.shot: the camera slowly pulling back from saint mirren university
panels.action: The camera pulls back, showing the entire majestic campus surrounded by green parks and glittering Seoul skyscrapers.
panels.prose_en: The camera pulls back, showing the entire majestic campus surrounded by green parks and glittering Seoul skyscrapers.
panels.prose_hi: Camra peeche ki or khinchta hai, jisme pura rajsi parisar hare-bhare parkon aur chamchamati seoul gaganchumbi imaaraton se ghira hua dikhta hai.

panels.shot: the city of seoul bathed in golden morning light under an azure sky
panels.action: The sprawling city of Seoul under a golden autumn morning, full of life, laughter, and hope.

dialogue.text: From a weak student weeping on a rainy rooftop... To the Sovereign who anchored the stars.

panels.prose_en: The sprawling city of Seoul under a golden autumn morning, full of life, laughter, and hope.
panels.prose_hi: Sharad ritu ki sunhari subah ke neeche seoul ka vishal shahar, jivan, hansi aur aasha se bhara hua.

panels.shot: the title card fading in over the horizon as chapter 98 concludes cliffhanger
panels.action: Golden script fades across the morning sky: 'DEMON SOVEREIGN'S BLOODLINE — CHAPTER 98 CONCLUDED.'

dialogue.text: ONLY TWO CHAPTERS REMAIN IN THE MASTER SAGA.

panels.prose_en: Golden script fades across the morning sky: 'DEMON SOVEREIGN'S BLOODLINE — CHAPTER 98 CONCLUDED.'.
panels.prose_hi: Subah ke aakash mein sunhari lipi dhundhli ho jaati hai: 'danav samprabhu ki raktarekha - adhyay 98 samapt.'
